title: feat(settings,plugin-email): state the live mail transport on Setup → Email
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuACdPWFJTLDcTrByFCHLzqb)_

Part of #25335 — the server half. The card stays open for the console half (see *What is left*).

Clause-②: yes (widening: service-settings exports SettingsService.registerLiveStatus / liveStatusOf, SettingsLiveStatus, SettingsLiveStatusProvider and SETTINGS_LIVE_STATUS_BANNER_ID; nothing is refused)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

Setup → Email showed what is stored, not what is in use. Out of the box the `mail` namespace stores provider `smtp` with an empty host, so the form reads as SMTP while every message goes to the development log and is recorded in `sys_email` as sent. The page now states the live transport at the top.

- **`@objectstack/service-settings`:** `SettingsService.registerLiveStatus(namespace, provider)` and `liveStatusOf(namespace, ctx)`. `GET /api/settings/:namespace` asks the provider on every read and puts its answer first in `manifest.specifiers`, as a spec-valid `info_banner` with the reserved id `live_status` (`SETTINGS_LIVE_STATUS_BANNER_ID`). The registered manifest and in-process `getNamespace()` are unchanged. The banner is added in the route, not in `getNamespace()`, because the mail plugin calls `getNamespace('mail')` while rebuilding the transport the statement waits on. A provider that throws gives an error-severity "Live status unavailable" banner and one `warn` line; the statement is never silently dropped.
- **`@objectstack/plugin-email`:** registers the `mail` statement (`src/live-transport-status.ts`). The branch is `EmailService.isConfigured()`:
  - `false` (log transport): **"No mail leaves this machine"**, warning severity. The body says messages are recorded in `sys_email` as sent and none is delivered.
  - `true`: **"Mail is delivered through SMTP (host:port)"**, or Resend, Postmark, or a host-supplied transport, at info severity.
  - The provider first waits for any `mail` re-apply still running. A read made just after a save then names the transport that save built.

**Landing:** the claim expected `plugin-email` and `service-settings`, and that is where the change landed. The page is built from `GET /api/settings/:namespace` (manifest plus values). The descriptor lives in `service-settings/src/manifests/mail.manifest.ts`, and the live fact lives in `plugin-email`. No `packages/spec` change: `info_banner` (`bannerText`, `bannerSeverity`) already exists, and the console already renders it.

**One pattern:** the SMS page does not state its live sender today, so there was no reader shape to copy. `registerLiveStatus` is namespace-generic; `service-sms` can register the same statement from `ISmsService.isConfigured()`.

## What is left — the console half (not done here)

The statement follows a swap **on the next read of the page**, not yet in place after Save. `@object-ui/console` 18.0.0 (`SettingsView`, read from the npm tarball because this session has no objectui access) merges only the PUT response's `values` into the page after a save. It keeps the manifest from its first GET and never refetches, so the banner keeps the pre-save statement until the page is reloaded. The fix is a console change: refetch `GET /api/settings/:namespace` after a successful save, or after any action. The server already answers the new statement on that read.

`Seam: runtime:service-settings GET /api/settings/:namespace manifest.specifiers[0] (info_banner id live_status) → renderer:@object-ui/console SettingsView save handler (merges PUT values only; manifest never re-read)`

## Tests

- `plugin-email/src/live-transport-status.pin.test.ts` (5 tests): pins the reading of `isConfigured()`. It covers the out-of-the-box state, a swap saved from the page (read before the re-apply settles), and that the branch is `isConfigured()`, not the transport class.
- `service-settings/src/settings-routes.live-status.pin.test.ts` (6 tests): the banner heads the GET payload and parses under `SettingsNamespacePayloadSchema`. The provider is asked on every read, the registered manifest stays untouched, nothing is added without a provider, a throwing provider gets an error banner, and an unknown namespace is refused.
- Three route-test fakes gained `liveStatusOf: async () => undefined` (the read route now calls it).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email test`: 37 files / 676 tests passed. Typecheck passed (`tsc --noEmit && check:test-typecheck`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings test`: 60 files / 995 tests passed. Typecheck passed.

**Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; every leg restored to the HEAD blob with an empty `git diff HEAD`):
1. `if (!source.isConfigured())` replaced by `if (!(source.options.transport instanceof LogTransport))`: 5 tests went red, but with `ReferenceError: LogTransport is not defined`. That is a crash, not the mutation, so this run does not count; it is reported here, not hidden.
2. The same branch replaced by `source.options.transport.constructor.name === 'LogTransport'`: 1 failed, 4 passed. The red test is "the branch is isConfigured(), not the transport class".
3. The same branch replaced by `if (false)`: 4 failed, 1 passed.
4. `await Promise.allSettled([...applying]);` deleted from the plugin: 1 failed, the swap test (`expected 'warning' to be 'info'`).

## Gates (local, at 4789209944)

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 70 commands, and all 70 exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "70 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 70 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". One gate needed a fix along the way: on the first sweep, `check:engine-double-contract` flagged the new pin's fake engine `update()`. The fake now declares only `find()`, which is all this boot reads. Everything CI runs beyond the derived set is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- The `live_status` banner has no zh-CN, ja-JP or es-ES text. Its text is computed per request, and the console's banner lookup by id would replace it with a fixed translation. A translated statement needs per-state ids or a parameterised lookup.
- With no email plugin mounted, the page states nothing new. The `mail/test` fallback already says no email service is mounted.
- `origin/main` moved 7 commits since the base `f0fdd45bbc`. None touch `plugin-email` or `service-settings`, so no merge was taken.
